keyPhrases.text: I had a better time there than I did during the performance itself
hasn't provided the show underneath the makeover with sufficient focus or muscle
all too often, I couldn't really hear them
Eddie Redmayne is on his own look-at-me planet

reasoning: While acknowledging talented performers and impressive atmosphere/production design, the review is fundamentally critical of the core theatrical experience. The critic explicitly states preferring the pre-show to the actual performance, criticizes the direction as lacking focus, and finds major fault with how songs are delivered. The tone suggests disappointment rather than recommendation.
